categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through early or timely payment before coercive enforcement or appeal. Advances the softgoal 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Make +100) and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost' (Help +50). Performance is judged against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' (id=112) and 'Average time to case closure (days)' (id=114).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=12 as seen in frequent variants like V0002, V0004, and V0007 where payment occurs shortly after fine creation or notification without requiring enforcement or appeal steps.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through payment occurring after penalties and notifications have been processed. Contributes to 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Help +50). Evaluated against indicator 'Average time to case closure (days)' (id=114).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=13, evidenced in variants such as V0009 and V0010 where payments follow notification and penalty additions prior to final coercive credit collection.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Represents cases resolved through an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture. Preserves offender due-process rights (Help +50) while incurring administrative costs and delaying revenue (SomeNegative -25). Evaluated against indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)' (id=113).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=14, observed in variants such as V0008, V0057, and V0135 which record steps including inserting date appeal to Prefecture, sending the appeal, and receiving results.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Represents cases resolved through a judicial appeal to the Judge. Strongly preserves due-process rights (Make +100) while hurting administrative and enforcement costs (Hurt -50). Evaluated against indicator 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)' (id=175).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=19, identified in variants like V0103, V0176, and V0140 containing judicial appeal actions.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Represents fine cases that proceed to coercive credit collection after all voluntary payment windows and notifications have passed. Helps maximize revenue through enforcement (Help +50) but hurts administrative costs (Hurt -50). Evaluated against 'Average time to case closure (days)' (id=114).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=20, supported by frequent and extreme variants like V0001 where cases conclude with the 'Send for Credit Collection' activity.
